SmartResumeDeliveryPayload.description: The SmartResume-delivery payload: the resolved recipient plus the already-signed OBv3 credential(s), forwarded by the SmartResume Adapter as the CredentialConnect POST /api/v1/credentials body (the adapter adds @context and protocol fields itself). synthesis_allowed is false for this phase (no Field Synthesis step provisioned).

recipient.description: The credential recipient. Only the id is derivable from this phase's sources — do not invent contact fields (name, email) that the sources do not carry.

id.description: Recipient identifier — the recipient DID resolved upstream by the Profile Resolver.

credentials.description: The complete signed OBv3 credential(s) from the Issuer Adapter, passed through verbatim as a single-element array.
